name: 28734 · Franklin, NC
findings: ZIP 28734 (Franklin) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28734 (Franklin) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
